All 17 playbook rules have been reviewed and submitted. Summary:

**Deviations / missing (redlines proposed):**
- **LOL-CAP** (critical) — Section 15 is mutual and excludes consequential damages but sets no monetary cap at all; added the greater-of 12 months' fees / USD 1M mutual cap plus expanded Excluded Claims.
- **ASSIGN** (high) — blanket consent bar with no affiliate/M&A carve-out; added successor and affiliate assignment rights and a no-change-of-control-termination confirmation.
- **NOSOLICIT** (medium) — mutual *no-hire* over all employees with no general-ad carve-out; narrowed to a non-solicit of involved personnel with carve-outs.
- **IP** (critical) — Garman owns the bespoke Modifications with only a restricted use licence back and no data-ownership statement; added licence-back and Sparkling data ownership.
- **LICENSE** (high) — licence is non-transferable and excludes contractors; added contractors and successor transferability.
- **INSURANCE** (low) — no insurance covenant; inserted standard limits as Section 20(k).
- **TRANSITION** (medium) — exit obligations run one way only; inserted Section 17(d) transition assistance, data return and certified deletion.

**Compliant:** INDEMN (Vendor IP indemnity outside the cap), NONCOMPETE, EXCLUSIVITY, MFN, T4C (90-day convenience right, at fallback), RENEWAL (no auto-renewal), GOVLAW (Nova Scotia — off-list but our home jurisdiction and non-exclusive), AUDIT, LD, WARRANTY (12-month conformance with repair/refund), MINCOMMIT.
